title: Interest daily closure succeeded
description: This event occurs when the daily closure step of the closing process is completed with product interest management. When the step generates reports, it is sent after all reports are resolved.

external_operation_id.title: External operation ID
external_operation_id.description: Identifier sent by the client in the external_id field of the daily closure request.

operation_date.title: Operation date
operation_date.description: Operation date, represents the day being closed.
